label: Binance USD-M Futures
notes: apiRestrictions: withdrawals OFF and futures trading ON.
terms_note: Signed REST API (HMAC-SHA256 over the query string, X-MBX-APIKEY header). Leveraged derivatives: place_order and cancel_order move real funds. Futures market-data endpoints accept the extra timestamp/signature parameters (checked live 2026-09-24).

fields.name: api_key
fields.help: Binance API key (sent as X-MBX-APIKEY). Create it under API Management with withdrawals OFF; restrict it to your IP. Futures testnet: create a key at https://testnet.binancefuture.com and point adapter.base_url there (testnet keys only work on the testnet host).

fields.name: api_secret
fields.help: The key's HMAC secret: signs every request (HMAC-SHA256 hex over the exact query string, appended as `signature` after `timestamp`). Never sent on the wire.

me.note: Signed GET /fapi/v1/accountConfig (weight 5): canTrade, canWithdraw, dualSidePosition (Hedge mode), multiAssetsMargin, feeTier.

list_markets.note: Every contract in one response (no pagination; `query` is not sent). `raw` carries filters and precisions.

get_ticker.note: 24h rolling statistics; decimal strings passed through. Futures tickers carry no bid/ask (that is /ticker/bookTicker, not mapped).

get_candles.note: Intervals 1m,3m,5m,15m,30m,1h,2h,4h,6h,8h,12h,1d,3d,1w,1M. Rows are positional arrays (oldest first); `time` is the open time in ms and prices are decimal strings. Rows carry prices as decimal strings (and Binance the open time as an integer); they are returned as numbers and `time` as a string, as the vocabulary types them (live check 2026-09-26: the raw values failed the output schema).

list_orders.note: Open orders only; without `symbol` the call is heavy (weight 40). `status` is not sent.

place_order.note: PLACES A REAL ORDER WITH REAL FUNDS on the configured host; it is not a simulation. Test with the futures testnet https://testnet.binancefuture.com first (edit adapter.base_url to point there), and never place an order the user has not explicitly confirmed. This opens or adds to a LEVERAGED position at the account's current leverage. `quantity` is in the base asset (e.g. BTC for BTCUSDT). Limit orders are sent with timeInForce=GTC and need `price`; omit `price` for market orders. positionSide is not sent (One-way mode); an account in Hedge mode rejects the order.

cancel_order.note: Binance requires `symbol` together with the order id.

auth: X-MBX-APIKEY header; TRADE/USER_DATA endpoints take `timestamp` and an HMAC-SHA256 hex `signature` over the full query string (same scheme as spot).

endpoints.notes: symbols[{symbol, pair, contractType, baseAsset, quoteAsset, marginAsset, status}]
array of {asset, balance, crossWalletBalance, crossUnPnl, availableBalance, ...}
LIMIT: timeInForce, quantity, price; MARKET: quantity

reference.limits: IP request weight per minute (2400 on USD-M) plus 10s/1min order-count limits; see exchangeInfo.rateLimits.

evidence: host fapi.binance.com: DNS ok, TLSv1.3 (DigiCert Inc)
probe: 8/8 tools answered on their documented path with an auth refusal, a validation error or data; control route answered 403 too, so the host authenticates before routing
HTML docs spot-check (render-doc): 8/8 tool paths found verbatim on their docs pages; every parameter and body key named on the page
live read without credentials: list_markets returned data that validates against the vocabulary
